items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Then Berry Brothers, sweet -- Pete Peaches and Duke, great act, sharp.

ctx.x: What was it that they did that made them your favorite?

Oh, the flips and struts, flips and strips, (inaudible) Berry big mouth, singing "Sweet Papadee," da-da-dee-da-da-dadoo-dee. --(inaudible) -- Arnis Berry every time he says Sweet Papa dee, zump, da, zump, off Raymond Berry's arm, and he's hitting that hat down there with it, tall hat.
Then Berry Brothers, sweet -- Pete Peaches and Duke, great act, sharp. And, lord, I could name so many.
